comparison.objective: Store a controlled drug in a locked cabinet as part of medication put-away, versus tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Item classification, cabinet operation, and storage; no evidenced adjustment-tool alignment or iterative response-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Controlled medication is secured in the appropriate locked cabinet; detailed scoring is absent. Candidate uses quantitative stroke, energy, velocity, rebound, and drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Secured storage does not test component commissioning despite the generic presence of locking.
